server/api/inspections-pdf-helpers.ts.reason: Resolves the immutable archive version for a report download. No route calls it, so the archive-version resolution it exists to perform never runs on a real download.

server/features/seat-quota/seat-banner.t.reason: A tenant-facing seat-quota banner that nothing renders. Seat enforcement is a SaaS-profile capability; the component was built ahead of the surface that would show it.

server/lib/ai/providers/recording.ts.reason: Its own header says TEST-ONLY AI transport: it records requests and replays canned text so a spec can assert what a caller asked for. Correct to be unreachable from production.

server/lib/audit-read-model.ts.reason: The projection over the two audit tables. Ledger section 40 Tasks 14-24 are written and committed but not executed, and this is the half of them that has no reader.

server/lib/audit-registry.ts.reason: How one metadata key renders in an audit entry. Same unshipped half of section 40 as the read model beside it.

server/lib/automation-core/schedule.ts.reason: Reminder due-time derived live from the event anchor. Mirrors a derivation that runs elsewhere; nothing in this deployment's reminder path calls this copy.

server/lib/compliance/legal-hold-release.reason: Ending a preservation order and returning the erasures it deferred. legal_holds shipped with a release shape and no route that performs the release.

server/lib/compliance/statutory-classifi.reason: Carries @gateConsumed: read as TEXT by a gate script, so the module graph cannot see the consumer. Split out of erasure-out-of-scope.ts on file size.

server/lib/editor-search.ts.reason: Editor full-text search helpers, built for competitor parity. The editor route does not import them, so the search they implement is not offered anywhere.

server/lib/icons.tsx.reason: A centralised icon registry of 27 Heroicons paths. Components import icons directly instead, so the registry that was meant to end that never took over.

server/lib/inspection-resolvers.ts.reason: Explicit resolver functions for unit/section/item resolution. Pure, tested, and not called by the code that resolves those things today.

server/lib/legal/non-translatable-manife.reason: Carries @gateConsumed: the eleven-category registry is read as text by scripts/check-non-translatable.mjs, which the module graph cannot see.

server/lib/legal/non-translatable-out-of.reason: The companion out-of-scope register to the manifest above, read by the same gate script rather than imported.

server/lib/mcp/snapshot-helpers.ts.reason: Shared reduction used by the OpenAPI snapshot GENERATOR and its drift gate - both scripts. Nothing in the worker needs it at runtime.

server/lib/migration-intake/infer-templa.reason: Turns a document's text into a template outline and refuses to call it a template until somebody looks. Part of the PDF-inference path whose server side has no route.

server/lib/migration-intake/pdf-content..reason: Reads text out of a page's content stream. Reachable only through pdf-text.ts, which is itself unreachable - one cluster, not three findings.

server/lib/migration-intake/pdf-fonts.ts.reason: How to read the bytes a PDF shows through a given font. Same PDF-inference cluster as pdf-content and pdf-text.

server/lib/migration-intake/pdf-text.ts.reason: PDF bytes to text, one string per page. The head of the PDF-inference reading cluster, and nothing on a route calls it.

server/lib/rbac/can-edit.ts.reason: A canEdit permission matrix from an earlier design-system phase. The decision it answers is made elsewhere today, so this copy is not consulted.

server/lib/report-section-numbering.ts.reason: Report section numbering plus edit-permission helpers, built for competitor parity. No renderer imports them.

server/lib/report-style/infer-profile.ts.reason: Chooses a report appearance for a workspace arriving from another product. Part of the import path that has no step invoking it.

server/lib/section-applicability.ts.reason: Its own header says FROZEN / DEAD CODE: superseded by the authoring-surface unification, kept deliberately rather than deleted. Not work owed.

server/lib/subtype-specials.ts.reason: Commercial PCA subtype-special chains driven by Building Profile flags. The commercial PCA surface does not consult them.

server/lib/system-coverage.ts.reason: Commercial PCA system-coverage registry and standard attribution. Its own header calls attribution CORRECTNESS-CRITICAL for the conformance statement, and nothing produces that statement yet.

server/services/seed/backfill-people.ts.reason: A one-shot backfill under services/seed. Nothing schedules or exposes it, so it can only be run by editing code.

server/lib/statutory/groups.ts.reason: Expands repeatable field groups on an authority's form and refuses more instances than the page holds. Nothing declares groups yet: a group's capacity and slot names are measurements of one revision, established by a person who read that revision, so the first caller arrives with the first authored field map rather than from code.

server/lib/statutory/binding-policy.ts.reason: Refuses personal data bound onto a statutory form by a route that would store it. It guards a declaration the stored form values make about themselves, and the validation path that will call it runs when a form declaration is loaded -- which cannot happen until a form is published.
